reproducibility_disclosure: Docker image IDs are not bit-reproducible across builds: layer metadata includes timestamps. What is recorded here is enough to reconstruct an EQUIVALENT image independently - pinned base digest, hash-pinned wheel closure, Dockerfile hash and the 21 module digests - but an independent rebuild may produce a different image ID. Any future binding must be to a digest actually published and custody-held, not to a claim that a rebuild will reproduce this ID.
